name: Rohit Wójcik
summary: Backend Engineer with 6 years of experience designing and scaling high-throughput distributed systems. Specialized in building robust microservices using Java, gRPC, and REST, with a focus on optimizing database performance in PostgreSQL. Proven track record of improving system latency and infrastructure reliability in fast-paced product environments.

experience.title: Backend Engineer
experience.description: Re-architected the core order placement flow using Java and gRPC, reducing peak-hour latency by 35% and supporting up to 12,000 requests per second. Migrated legacy relational schemas to optimized PostgreSQL partition tables, improving query throughput by 40%. Collaborated within a team of 8 to deploy containerized microservices using Docker and monitored system health through distributed tracing.

experience.title: Software Engineer
experience.description: Designed and maintained secure REST APIs handling payment processing for over 50,000 active merchant accounts. Integrated Redis caching layers to decrease primary database load by 25% during high-traffic promotional periods. Utilized Git for version control and spearheaded the transition of manual deployment scripts into automated CI/CD pipelines.
